title: Basal insulin recording
symptom: In xDrip, users can only add bolus units, not basal units, making it difficult to track basal insulin injections like Lantus. The user currently adds Lantus as a bolus with a note, which is not ideal.
evidence_quote: I notice that in xdrip only we can add our Bolus units but not Basal units, pls we need a feature to add our Basal units as well to be reflected in the reports so we can track our records
